0022600178.text: The Grizzlies (6-1, 2nd in the West) host the Pacers (2-6, 12th in the East), with Memphis 4-0 on the road, 2-1 at home, and coming off a loss, while Indiana has lost five straight. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Grizzlies won their 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 125-106 win in Indianapolis on March 1, 2026. Memphis is without Scotty Pippen Jr. (out, back soreness) and Quinten Post (day-to-day, ankle, game-time decision), while Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Obi Toppin (back soreness), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), and Kelly Oubre Jr. is day-to-day with a knee bruise and a game-time decision.
